Callout.Name: Horse Trailer - Suspected Theft
Callout.Message: Horse trailer believed to be carrying stolen animals.
Callout.Advisory: One vehicle, plates not matching the trailer.

Script.Line: The trailer is not mine. I am moving it for somebody.
There is nothing in the back. What do you mean, something in the back.
I am not opening it. It is not my trailer.

Lines.Approach: Plate does not match the trailer and there is something alive in the back.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
